narrative: The company book open on the tiring-house table. Heminges's hand has just left two words on a clean line. No sum under them. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Saw the two words go in, and left them.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Wrote play on, and looked at it.

entities.name: the company book
entities.context: Shown on ledger in Two words in the book
